local_lemmas.name: idem
local_lemmas.role: Turns self-products into anchors and supplies the final RHS expansion by symmetry.
local_lemmas.proof_shape: (congrArg (fun t => a ◇ t) (h a a a)).trans ((h a a (a ◇ a)).symm)

local_lemmas.name: absorb
local_lemmas.role: Collapses a nested right-anchor context after two idempotence-driven expansions.
local_lemmas.proof_shape: two congrArg lifts of (idem a).symm, then (h a b a).symm

local_lemmas.name: extend
local_lemmas.statement: ∀ (a b : G), b ◇ a = (b ◇ a) ◇ a
local_lemmas.role: Re-expands an anchored product so the goal can close by one more idempotence lift.
local_lemmas.proof_shape: ((absorb (b ◇ a) a).symm).trans (congrArg (fun t => (b ◇ a) ◇ t) (absorb a b))

local_lemmas.name: final calc
local_lemmas.role: Composes extension with idempotence under a right context.
local_lemmas.proof_shape: calc lhs = (x ◇ y) ◇ y := extend y x; _ = rhs := congrArg ... ((idem y).symm)

newly_solved_true_428_3725.proof_excerpt:
import JudgeProblem

def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  intro x y
  have idem : ∀ (a : G), a ◇ a = a := by
    intro a
    exact (congrArg (fun t => a ◇ t) (h a a a)).trans ((h a a (a ◇ a)).symm)
  have absorb : ∀ (a b : G), a ◇ (b ◇ a) = a := by
    intro a b
    exact ((congrArg (fun t => a ◇ (b ◇ t)) ((idem a).symm)).trans
      ((congrArg (fun t => a ◇ (b ◇ (a ◇ t))) ((idem a).symm)).trans
        ((h a b a).symm)))
  have extend : ∀ (a b : G), b ◇ a = (b ◇ a) ◇ a := by
    intro a b
    exact ((absorb (b ◇ a) a).symm).trans (congrArg (fun t => (b ◇ a) ◇ t) (absorb a b))
  calc
    x ◇ y = (x ◇ y) ◇ y := extend y x
    _ = (x ◇ y) ◇ (y ◇ y) := congrArg (fun t => (x ◇ y) ◇ t) ((idem y).symm)

recommendation_v095.target: anchored projection and argument-erasure local-lemma miner
rationale: v0.9.4 shows that a small local theory can safely close a composite goal when it derives idempotence, absorption, and extension as named local lemmas.
The highest-ranked remaining cases need the same style of local lemma, but with anchored projection or argument-erasure instead of only extension.

The safest next step is not broader graph search; it is a narrowly gated miner for lemmas such as (a ◇ b) ◇ b = b, (a ◇ b) ◇ a = a, a ◇ a = b ◇ a, and a ◇ b = a ◇ c when the hypothesis has a repeated-anchor RHS.
